examples.text_zh: 优秀的所有者能让整个生意保持兴旺。

examples.text_en: The proprietorship of the land passed to his son.
examples.text_zh: 这片土地的所有权传给了他的儿子。

examples.text_en: They changed the proprietorship of the whole company.
examples.text_zh: 他们变更了整个公司的所有权。

examples.text_en: He acted with propriety in front of the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 他在整个小组面前举止得体。

examples.text_en: They questioned the propriety of his whole act.
examples.text_zh: 他们对他整个行为的得体性提出质疑。

examples.text_en: The propulsion of the small thing was very strong.
examples.text_zh: 这个小东西的推进力非常强。

examples.text_en: They used a new system for the propulsion of the thing.
examples.text_zh: 他们用一种新系统来推进这个东西。

examples.text_en: The king would prorogue the group for a month.
examples.text_zh: 国王会让这个团体休会一个月。

examples.text_en: They will prorogue the meeting until a later time.
examples.text_zh: 他们会让会议休会到稍后。

examples.text_en: His prosaic words made the whole talk too long.
examples.text_zh: 他平铺直叙的话让整场讲话太长了。

examples.text_en: It was a prosaic day with nothing at all to do.
examples.text_zh: 那是平淡无奇的一天，无事可做。

examples.text_en: The new law will proscribe the old bad act.
examples.text_zh: 新法律将禁止那种旧的不良行为。

examples.text_en: They proscribe any use of the land for that.
examples.text_zh: 他们禁止把那片土地用于那种用途。

examples.text_en: They will prosecute the man for the whole act.
examples.text_zh: 他们将就该行为起诉这个人。

examples.text_en: The court can prosecute a person for a bad act.
examples.text_zh: 法庭可以因不良行为起诉一个人。

examples.text_en: The prosecution told the court about the whole event.
examples.text_zh: 控方向法庭陈述了整个事件。

examples.text_en: They faced prosecution for the act against the law.
examples.text_zh: 他们因违法行为面临起诉。

examples.text_en: They would proselytize in the old part of the city.
examples.text_zh: 他们会在老城区劝人改信宗教。

examples.text_en: He tried to proselytize people at the school.
examples.text_zh: 他试图在学校里劝人改变信仰。

examples.text_en: The prospect of a new job made him very happy.
examples.text_zh: 新工作的前景让他非常高兴。

examples.text_en: The view gave us a fine prospect of the sea.
examples.text_zh: 这景色让我们看到了大海的美景。

examples.text_en: They like prospecting for gold in the old land.
examples.text_zh: 他们喜欢在那片旧土地上勘探黄金。

examples.text_en: Prospecting for oil took most of the year.
examples.text_zh: 勘探石油花了这一年的大部分时间。

examples.text_en: The prospective change looked good for the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 这一预期中的变化对整个小组来说看似不错。

examples.text_en: They gave the prospective group a short talk.
examples.text_zh: 他们给这批未来的成员做了简短介绍。

examples.text_en: The old prospector looked for gold in the land.
examples.text_zh: 老勘探者在这片土地上寻找黄金。

examples.text_en: A prospector can work alone for many long days.
examples.text_zh: 勘探者能独自工作很多天。

examples.text_en: The prospectus told of the whole plan for the school.
examples.text_zh: 这份说明书讲述了学校的整个计划。

examples.text_en: They read the prospectus before they gave the money.
examples.text_zh: 他们在出资之前读了这份说明书。

examples.text_en: The small business will prosper that year.
examples.text_zh: 这家小企业那一年会兴旺起来。

examples.text_en: Good people can prosper with hard work and care.
examples.text_zh: 善良的人靠努力和用心就能兴旺。
